heroHeadline: Disputed Duma Vote Closes in Transnistria as Moldova Reports Another Unconfirmed Drone Sighting Near Its Center
heroSubtitle: Residents of Berezlogi and Dereneu — in Orhei and Călărași districts, closer to the geographic center of Moldova than any previous incident — reported a drone-like object and a mid-air explosion overnight into September 20; police found no debris to confirm a crash, but the Foreign Ministry still condemned the reported overflight as an unacceptable sovereignty violation, the sixteenth reported airspace incident since the crisis began August 9. Separately, voting in Russia's disputed State Duma election closed across Transnistria's 17 polling stations after more than 21,000 residents cast ballots by midday, a process Moldova's government maintains it never authorised beyond the single Russian Embassy station in Chisinau.
